size.$description: Fixed control and layout heights. These exist so a button, an input and a select line up on the same row without each component hard-coding its own height - the values were literal rem numbers scattered across component CSS before.

focus-ring.$description: A single focus-ring definition for the whole system. Keyboard focus visibility is a WCAG 2.4.7 requirement, and it was previously drawn three different ways (2px/3px outlines with +2px/+3px/-2px offsets) across components.
